from pathlib import Path
for key in ('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','OMP_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS'):os.environ[key]='1'
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm
started=time.monotonic();source=Path(__file__).read_bytes();input_path=Path(sys.argv[1]);raw=input_path.read_bytes();cap=json.loads(raw)
expected='bd4d5e1d0e9fcfadef72cc9dba2cc4f7e6efacc6a577ee331fcd5b82574e5e49';assert cap['capsule']['source_sha256']==expected
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='centre-global-frozen-') as directory:
    replay=Path(directory)
    for name,text in cap['capsule']['source_bytes_at_IMPORT'].items():
        assert Path(name).name==name and hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()==cap['capsule']['source_sha256_at_IMPORT'][name]
        (replay/name).write_text(text)
    sys.path.insert(0,str(replay))
    import covariant_root_transfer as root
    from covariant_induced_photon import Parameters,phi_frame
    edges=((0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(0,4),(4,5),(4,6),(4,7),(1,5))
    model=root.BosonicEdgeModel(8,edges)
    masks=sum((np.rint(np.diag(model.n(i)).real).astype(int)*(1<<i) for i in range(8)),np.zeros(model.dimension,dtype=int))
    Xstars=root.tensor_pauli(['X' if edge in ((0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(4,5),(4,6),(4,7)) else 'I' for edge in model.edges])
    adjacency={i:[] for i in range(8)}
    for a,b in edges[:-1]:adjacency[a].append(b);adjacency[b].append(a)
    def path(start,end):
        queue=[(start,)];seen={start}
        while queue:
            p=queue.pop(0)
            if p[-1]==end:return p
            for other in adjacency[p[-1]]:
                if other not in seen:seen.add(other);queue.append((*p,other))
        raise ArithmeticError('Disconnected actual primitive tree')
    E={}
    for i,j in itertools.product(range(8),repeat=2):E[i,j]=model.n(i) if i==j else model.bilinear(i,j,path=path(j,i))
    graph={m:[] for m in range(256)};pattern_error=0.
    for i,j in itertools.product(range(8),repeat=2):
        actual=Xstars@E[i,j].conj()@Xstars;target=(model.identity if i==j else 0)-E[j,i]
        pattern_error=max(pattern_error,float(np.linalg.norm((abs(actual)>1e-10).astype(int)-(abs(target)>1e-10).astype(int))))
        for row,col in np.argwhere(abs(actual)>1e-10):graph[int(masks[col])].append((int(masks[row]),target[row,col]/actual[row,col]))
    assert pattern_error==0
    phase={};consistency=0.
    for seed in range(256):
        if seed in phase:continue
        phase[seed]=1.+0j;queue=[seed]
        while queue:
            old=queue.pop()
            for new,ratio in graph[old]:
                desired=ratio*phase[old]
                if new in phase:consistency=max(consistency,abs(phase[new]-desired))
                else:phase[new]=desired;queue.append(new)
    assert consistency<1e-12
    C0=np.diag([phase[int(m)] for m in masks])@Xstars
    error=max(float(np.linalg.norm(C0@E[i,j].conj()@C0.conj().T-((model.identity if i==j else 0)-E[j,i]))) for i,j in E)
    chord=model.bilinear(1,5,path=(5,1));reverse=model.bilinear(5,1,path=(1,5))
    chord_error=float(np.linalg.norm(C0@chord.conj()@C0.conj().T+reverse))
    old=json.loads((input_path.parent/'covariant_centre_neutral_stat_20261008.json').read_bytes())
    local_phase={int(k):complex(v['real'],v['imag']) for k,v in old['actual_phase_table'].items()}
    local=np.diag([local_phase[int(m)&15]*local_phase[int(m)>>4] for m in masks])@Xstars
    local_spatial_error=float(np.linalg.norm(local@chord.conj()@local.conj().T+reverse))
    gamma,_=phi_frame(Parameters());_,basis=np.linalg.eigh(gamma[0]);frame=np.column_stack((basis[:,2:],basis[:,:2]))
    Rb=frame.conj().T@(-1j*gamma[1]@gamma[2]@gamma[3])@frame;values,vectors=np.linalg.eigh(Rb);minus=vectors[:,values<0]
    Pminus=minus@minus.conj().T
    GR=expm(1j*math.pi*(root.native_lift(model,Pminus)+root.native_lift(model,Pminus,4)));C=GR@C0
    external=[]
    for index,edge in enumerate(model.edges):
        if edge not in ((0,4),(1,5)):continue
        word=['I']*len(edges);word[index]='Z';Z=root.tensor_pauli(word)
        external.append(dict(edge=edge,C_Z_Cdag_error=float(np.linalg.norm(C@Z.conj()@C.conj().T-Z))))
    stabilizer=model.stabilizers[0];Serror=float(np.linalg.norm(C@stabilizer.conj()@C.conj().T-stabilizer))
    assert error<1e-11 and chord_error<1e-11 and Serror<1e-11 and max(r['C_Z_Cdag_error'] for r in external)<1e-11, json.dumps(dict(all64=error,chord=chord_error,S=Serror,external=external,naive=local_spatial_error))
    result=dict(source_bytes=source.decode(),source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
        input=dict(path=str(input_path),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),frozen_root_sha256=expected),
        runtime=dict(executable=sys.executable,python=sys.version,numpy=np.__version__),
        geometry='Actual root 8-edge primitive graph interpreted as TWO four-mode body fibres for this spatial PH test, not claiming its second fibre remains Ref4 here. Previous separate Ref4-neutral probe remains valid.',
        native_full_dimension=model.dimension,all64_primitive_matrixunit_antiCAR_error=error,
        actual_direct_spatial_chord_antiCAR_error=chord_error,product_of_independently_seeded_local_PH_spatial_error=local_spatial_error,
        all_spatial_Dstat_Z_controls=external,actual_statistical_stabilizer_C_error=Serror,
        phase_consistency_error=consistency,global_occupation_phase_table={str(k):dict(real=v.real,imag=v.imag) for k,v in phase.items()},
        lesson='Onsite number-complement/matrixunit proof alone leaves relative phases between local number sectors undetermined. Check physical spatial hops. Global occupation-diagonal phase correction is solved from actual primitive paths, while X support stays only on onsite edges; therefore spatial Dstat still commutes. No independent Fock isometry or new state.',
        scope='Executed ideal primitive spatial antiCAR/defect representation. Does not certify whole field/outside law or SAME moving-photon/source CP trace. Gamma(R) and connection/centre descent still need the stated actual ideal-kernel assumptions.',
        elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
    Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(output=sys.argv[2],source_sha256=result['source_sha256'],all64_antiCAR_error=error,
        direct_chord_error=chord_error,naive_local_product_chord_error=local_spatial_error,
        spatial_Z_error=max(r['C_Z_Cdag_error'] for r in external),S_error=Serror,elapsed_seconds=result['elapsed_seconds'])))
    print('Natural exit: actual global primitive antiCAR phase, spatial hop, Dstat and statistical cycle')
